changes: Routine info and debug console logs of Lyre scripts can now be turned on per script with the new debug setting in the lyre_bridge config.lua. They are hidden by default, warnings and errors are always shown.
You can also turn them on from your server config with set lyre_bridge:debug true for every script, or set lyre_bridge:lyre_hunting:debug true for a single one.
If you keep your own lyre_bridge config.lua, copy the new debug block from the new file. Without it, routine logs simply stay hidden.
Global server convars set to false (for example set lyre_bridge:backgroundBlur false) are now applied. They were still ignored in 2.3.0.
!! IMPORTANT !! Lyre scripts released on 2026-10-14 need this version, update lyre_bridge before installing them.
The background blur and the HUD show and hide hooks are now set once in the lyre_bridge config.lua and apply to every Lyre script.
A blur or HUD setting kept in a script's config.lua still overrides the bridge setting.
Setting a true or false option to false through a server convar now correctly turns it off.
Fixes job and gang garages on QBCore and Qbox by providing numeric job grades and gang data.
Fixes ESX players being treated as members of the ballas gang.
Fixes QBCore item metadata not being saved (for example jerry can fuel levels) and item counts split across several slots.
Fixes ox_target interaction zones not being removed correctly.
QBCore society accounts now require qb-banking.
Fixes Qbox vehicle keys sometimes not being given on freshly spawned vehicles.
Fixes vehicle key removal on Qbox and QBCore.
Fixes Qbox vehicle keys so granted keys stay with the vehicle instead of being lost on resync.
Improves admin rank detection on Qbox to support more rank names and both ace group conventions.
Fixes admin rank detection on Qbox so Lyre admin commands work correctly.
Adds compatibility with the cd_dispatch3d dispatch script.
Adds compatibility with the tgiann_inventory script.
Stability fixes on the target system and on third party provider integrations.
getAdminRank now returns a `{ rank = true }` set on every framework (ESX, QBCore, Qbox) so consumers can use `rank[name] == true` uniformly.
Update lyre_garage alongside this release to restore admin commands on QBCore.
Add skillcheck module with an ox_lib provider (bridge.skillcheck.run).
Make sure to update every Lyre resource alongside this release. The previous one was broken.
Official open-source bridge release.
Add startup version check against lyrescripts/versions.
Expose bridge integrations, shared imports, and automatic SQL migrations for Lyre resources.
